title: ComplyFlow Canvas App Design Specification
description: Local Power Apps design/reference artifact — NOT an exported Power Apps package. Defines screen hierarchies, control bindings, and formulas for manual construction in Power Apps Studio.

screens.purpose: Operational KPI summary and primary workflow navigation
Intake form for submitting new compliance reviews with client-side required field validation
Personal worklist filtered by current user email and sorted by urgent deadline

gallery.name: gal_MyQueue
gallery.itemsFormula: SortByColumns(Filter(ComplianceRequests, Status <> 'Closed', (AssignedAnalyst.Email = varCurrentUser.Email || AssignedAnalystEmail = varCurrentUser.Email), (IsBlank(txt_SearchMyQueue.Text) || StartsWith(RequestID, txt_SearchMyQueue.Text) || StartsWith(Title, txt_SearchMyQueue.Text))), 'TargetDueDateTime', SortOrder.Ascending)

screens.purpose: Searchable case repository with multi-criteria filters for process area, risk, and status

gallery.name: gal_AllRequests
gallery.itemsFormula: SortByColumns(Filter(ComplianceRequests, (IsBlank(txt_MasterSearch.Text) || StartsWith(RequestID, txt_MasterSearch.Text) || StartsWith(Title, txt_MasterSearch.Text)), (cmb_MasterProcessArea.Selected.Value = 'All' || ProcessArea.Value = cmb_MasterProcessArea.Selected.Value), (cmb_MasterRisk.Selected.Value = 'All' || RiskLevel.Value = cmb_MasterRisk.Selected.Value), (cmb_MasterStatus.Selected.Value = 'All' || Status.Value = cmb_MasterStatus.Selected.Value)), 'TargetDueDateTime', SortOrder.Ascending)

screens.purpose: Comprehensive case dossier displaying metadata, live SLA countdown, approvals, escalations, and audit history
Operational action screen to reassign analysts, transition status, and record closure findings
